WITH SegmentMinConsumption AS (
    -- Find the minimum consumption value for each segment in 2013
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        MIN(ym.Consumption) as min_cons
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
SegmentAvgConsumption AS (
    -- Calculate the annual average consumption for customers who hit that minimum
    -- Formula: Total consumption of those specific customers / count of those customers
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) / COUNT(ym.CustomerID) as avg_cons
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN SegmentMinConsumption smc ON c.Segment = smc.Segment AND ym.Consumption = smc.min_cons
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
SegmentValues AS (
    -- Pivot the values for easy subtraction
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_cons END) as sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_cons END) as lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_cons END) as kam_avg
    FROM SegmentAvgConsumption
)
SELECT 
    (sme_avg - lam_avg) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (lam_avg - kam_avg) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (kam_avg - sme_avg) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM SegmentValues;

    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN SegmentMinConsumption smc ON c.Segment = smc.Segment AND ym.Consumption = smc.min_cons
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
SegmentValues AS (
    -- Pivot the values for easy subtraction
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_cons END) as sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_cons END) as lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_cons END) as kam_avg
    FROM SegmentAvgConsumption
)
SELECT 
    (sme_avg - lam_avg) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (lam_avg - kam_avg) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (kam_avg - sme_avg) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM SegmentValues;
